audit.whatIsWrong: Four fields (whys[1], spikes[0], early, wants.foe[1]) tell the player Steadfast Presence (W) grounds him so he 'can't kite or disengage'. Riot's text: it stops enemy DASHES, and only a stopped dash is slowed and grounded.
audit.why: Dr. Mundo has no dash anywhere in his kit — Blunt Force Trauma (E) has range 0 and no movement. Poppy's W therefore does nothing to Mundo except give her armour, MR and move speed. The page was telling him to fear the one ability in her kit that cannot touch him, and 'Extend into her W' was listed as the losing trade.
audit.corrected: W restated as resists-plus-anti-dash in phases[2].why, breakdown.cooldowns, spikes[0], early and whys[1]; tradeBad repointed at the real losing trade (fighting beside a wall).

audit.whatIsWrong: Heroic Charge is described as a 'wall-pin stun' with no statement of the condition, and Iron Ambassador's shield is never mentioned at all.
audit.why: Heroic Charge stuns ONLY if the target is pushed into a wall — in open lane it is a displacement and nothing more, which makes standing position the entire counterplay. Iron Ambassador leaves a buckler she picks up for a shield, and that shield is what eats a committed Mundo burst.
audit.corrected: Wall condition stated in phases[2].why, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, spikes[0], early and tradeBad; buckler shield added to phases[5].why and wants.foe[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 and First item are given to Dr. Mundo in both layers, while content whys[4] ('Her level-6 R interrupts your engages and out-trades your R sustain'), whys[5] ('the lane stays uphill'), spikes[1], spikes[2] and the packet chart all give both stages to Poppy.
audit.why: Five sources against two chart rows, at a 49.46% winrate over 833 games. Keeper's Verdict at 140s and her buckler shield genuinely hold the lane until Mundo's second item.
audit.corrected: Level 6 and First item flipped to Poppy in both layers as one chart edit; 2+ items stays Dr. Mundo.

audit.whatIsWrong: Only Heroic Charge carried a number (14s, which is right at rank 1); Steadfast Presence and Keeper's Verdict had none.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence is 20/18/16/14/12 and Keeper's Verdict 140/120/100 — the 140s ult is the longest cooldown in the lane and the one Mundo should be counting before he commits.
audit.corrected: Added to breakdown.cooldowns, phases[4].why and phases[2].why.

edits.before: Full kit online and your passive shrugs the first CC. Cleaver poke plus E-empowered swats start the grind; never brawl while Heroic Charge is up.
edits.after: Steadfast Presence only stops dashes — you have none, so it is just her resists. Heroic Charge (14s) needs a wall: fight in the open lane.

edits.before: Maximum Dosage online — dives and all-ins flip when you press R mid-fight and regen half your HP. Force Poppy to commit, then out-last the commit.
edits.after: Keeper's Verdict (140s at rank 1) throws you out of any fight you start, and she is untargetable through the channel. Hold your R until after it.

edits.before: Heartsteel timing — every proc widens the HP gap and your cleavers start hurting. Stand in the wave and dare Poppy to trade into the regen.
edits.after: Heartsteel widens the gap, but Hammer Shock still chunks you and her Iron Ambassador buckler shields your burst. Force the shield out, then commit.

edits.before: Extend into her W — that is the exchange Poppy wins flat.
edits.after: Trading beside a wall — Heroic Charge pins you there.

edits.before: - Poppy Heroic Charge (14s): matchup-defining — Wall-pin stun. Dodge it. Track it before every commit. - Your ultimate: spend it on kill windows, never on waves. - Summoners: track his Flash after any close call — it changes every dive call.
edits.after: - Heroic Charge (14s at rank 1): stuns only if it pins you to a wall — in open lane it is just a shove. - Steadfast Presence (20s) stops dashes, and you have none. - Keeper's Verdict is 140s at rank 1; count it before you commit.

edits.before: Track Poppy’s Heroic Charge (14s): Wall-pin stun. Dodge it. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Heroic Charge (14s at rank 1) only stuns if a wall is behind you. Stand in the open lane.

edits.before: Poppy out-trades you with her Hammer Shock (Q) percent-HP damage that punishes your big health bar, Steadfast Presence (W) grounding that stops you kiting, and a Heroic Charge (E) wall-stun that pins you for extra hits — every trade favors her.
edits.after: Poppy out-trades you with Hammer Shock (Q) chunking your health bar and Heroic Charge (E) pinning you to a wall for free hits. Steadfast Presence (W) only stops dashes and you have none — it is her resists, not a cage, so stay in the open.

edits.before: Poppy wins levels 1-3 hard: Hammer Shock (Q) does percent-max-HP damage that scales with your health, Steadfast Presence (W) grounds you so you can't disengage, and Heroic Charge (E) wall-stuns you for a punishing follow-up.
edits.after: Poppy wins levels 1-3 hard: Hammer Shock (Q) chunks your health bar and Heroic Charge (E) wall-stuns you for a punishing follow-up. Steadfast Presence (W) only grounds what it stops dashing — you have no dash, so fight in open lane.

edits.before: At level 2 her W grounding and Q chunk keep her ahead in every trade.
edits.after: At level 2 her Q chunk and buckler shield keep her ahead in trades.

edits.before: Ground you with Steadfast Presence (W) so you can't kite or chase
edits.after: Pick her Iron Ambassador buckler back up to shield your burst

notes: The suspectNames hit on 'Her Keeper's Verdict' is a FALSE POSITIVE — that is the correct name of Poppy's R. UNVERIFIED, so I neither repeated nor removed it where it stands alone (whys[0], whys[3], spikes[2], wants.you[0], wants.foe[0]): the page claims Hammer Shock deals percent-max-health damage. Riot's description says only 'damage and creating a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay', and the kit's derived flags do NOT include percentHealth for Q — so the claim is neither confirmed nor refuted by the data I am allowed to read. I removed it only from strings I was already rewriting for the W error, and left the standalone instances untouched. See questionsForUser.
